title: Design System: La Casa de Susana

display.purpose: One per page: the hero headline over photography, and catalogue and form page titles. Gambetta Light.

title.purpose: Every section heading. Gambetta Light, short measures.

headline.purpose: Sub-section headings inside a page: listing Description/Features/Location/Enquire, form step titles.

card-title.purpose: Listing card titles and small serif names.

label.purpose: Card operation tags, search captions, footer column headings. Sentence case.

shadows.purpose: The hero search bar floating over the hero photo.

shadows.name: photo-pill
shadows.purpose: White 'all photos' button over the listing gallery.

shadows.name: header-hairline
shadows.purpose: Bottom edge of the solid header.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Inputs on focus, with an ink border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Reveals, entrances, view transitions, nudges, progress.

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.purpose: Cross-fades, button states, hover zoom, chip selection.

motion.name: hero-crossfade
motion.value: opacity 1.8s ease-soft, every 7s; photo scale 1.08 to 1 over 9s linear
motion.purpose: Home hero cycling up to four featured listings; stops when an indicator is chosen.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.purpose: Hero headline, lede and villa chip on load; page titles use 20px over 1.1s.

motion.name: reveal-image
motion.value: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) to inset(0) 1.2s ease-out; image scale 1.12 to 1 over 1.8s ease-out; threshold 0.12
motion.purpose: Editorial photos unveil from the bottom once in view.

motion.name: v-reveal
motion.value: translateY(28px) + opacity 0 to rest; opacity 1s, transform 1.1s ease-out; rootMargin -8% bottom; --d stagger
motion.purpose: Headings, text and list items rise in once.

motion.name: step-transition
motion.value: translateX(±28px) + fade; opacity 0.35s ease-soft, transform 0.5s ease-out
motion.purpose: Form steps slide in the direction of travel.

motion.name: view-transition-root
motion.value: old: fade out 0.35s ease-soft; new: fade in + 12px rise 0.6s ease-out

motion.name: view-transition-listing
motion.purpose: Card photo morphs into the listing hero.

motion.name: hover-zoom
motion.purpose: The only photo hover. Gentle by design.

motion.name: link-under
motion.purpose: Nav and footer link underline draws from the left.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations 0.01ms; view transitions off; reveals shown; hero autoplay and zoom off

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink pill for the primary action on every surface; the arrow nudges on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn">Private search <svg class="ds-nudge" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Supreme', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--color-ink, #17221f); color: var(--color-paper, #ffffff); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--color-ink-2, #2a3833); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgb(23 34 31 / 0.45); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #17221f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nudge { transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-nudge { transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary pill: inset currentColor ring, fills ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Supreme', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px currentColor; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #17221f); color: var(--color-paper, #ffffff); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-ink, #17221f); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #17221f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-count { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; color: var(--color-muted, #6b6862); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover .ds-count { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); }

components.name: Light Button

components.css: .ds-dark { background: var(--color-ink, #17221f); padding: 24px; border-radius: 1.75rem; } .ds-btn-light { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Supreme', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; background: var(--color-paper, #ffffff); color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-light:hover { background: var(--color-stone, #f6f4f0); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-paper, #ffffff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 52px field with label above; ink border and soft halo on focus; money variant formats as you type.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; max-width: 22rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Supreme', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); } .ds-label em { font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-muted, #6b6862); } .ds-money { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.8rem 4rem 0.8rem 1rem; background: var(--color-paper, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e0d9); border-radius: 0.875rem; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-faint, #9b978f); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #cfcac1; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(23 34 31 / 0.08); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--color-alert, #b3361f); } .ds-suffix { position: absolute; right: 1rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-muted, #6b6862); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: 44px pill for single and multiple choice in forms; the chosen chip turns ink.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-chip { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e0d9); background: var(--color-paper, #ffffff); color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Supreme', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 0.3s; } .ds-chip input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #cfcac1; } .ds-chip.ds-on, .ds-chip:has(input:checked) { background: var(--color-ink, #17221f); border-color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); color: var(--color-paper, #ffffff); } .ds-chip:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #17221f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Counter

components.css: .ds-count-box { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; max-width: 20rem; height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e0d9); border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--color-paper, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Supreme', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-round { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-round:hover { background: var(--color-stone, #f6f4f0); } .ds-round:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #17221f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-val { min-width: 4rem; text-align: center; font-size: 1rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 24rem; color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Supreme', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-photo { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1.25rem; background: var(--color-stone-2, #ece8e1); } .ds-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #cfe3e6, #e9dcc6 60%, #b9a98a); transition: transform 2.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-img { transform: scale(1.025); } .ds-tag { position: absolute; left: 1rem; top: 1rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.95); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-arrow { position: absolute; right: 1rem; bottom: 1rem; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.95); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.7s; } .ds-card:hover .ds-arrow { opacity: 1; } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #17221f); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-title { margin-top: 1.25rem; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Gambetta', serif); font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-meta { margin-top: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted, #6b6862); } .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding-top: 1rem; } .ds-price { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-specs { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted, #6b6862); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1.2fr 1fr 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-paper, #ffffff); color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -30px rgb(23 34 31 / 0.45); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Supreme', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-seg { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; padding: 0.25rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-stone, #f6f4f0); } .ds-thumb { position: absolute; top: 0.25rem; bottom: 0.25rem; left: 0.25rem; width: calc(50% - 0.25rem); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-ink, #17221f); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-seg button { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 0.625rem 1.5rem; border: 0; background: none; font: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted, #6b6862); cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg .ds-seg-on { color: #fff; } .ds-sf { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 4rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 999px; transition: background-color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sf:hover { background: var(--color-stone, #f6f4f0); } .ds-cap { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--color-muted, #6b6862); } .ds-sv { font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-go { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; height: 3.75rem; padding: 0 2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-ink, #17221f); color: #fff; font: inherit; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-go:hover { background: var(--color-ink-2, #2a3833); } .ds-go:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #17221f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; height: 5rem; padding: 0 3rem; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-line, #e4e0d9); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); color: var(--color-ink, #17221f); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Supreme', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-badge { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 0.6rem; background: var(--color-mar, #13c6c9); color: #fff; } .ds-word { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Gambetta', serif); font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2rem; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.375rem 0; background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 0 100% / 0 1px no-repeat; transition: background-size 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { background-size: 100% 1px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #17221f); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-contact { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-ink, #17221f); color: #fff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.3s; } .ds-contact:hover { background: var(--color-ink-2, #2a3833); }

narrative.overview:
A white gallery whose exhibits are Ibiza houses. Pure white paper alternates with a warm stone ground; everything else steps back so the listing photography, large and softly rounded, carries all the colour on the page. Type is a light, refined serif for anything that speaks (Gambetta) and a clean grotesk for anything that works (Supreme). Actions are pine-black pills. The palette is deliberately colourless so a turquoise sea in a listing photo reads as the most saturated thing on screen.

Density is low and generous: sections breathe on 80px (phone) and 128px (desktop) vertical padding, cards sit in a three-up grid with 56px between rows, and copy is held to readable measures (36–58ch for ledes and body, 68ch for listing prose). The page is built for a phone first, at 390 wide: photo rails swipe, the listing gallery becomes a full-bleed strip, long forms break into short steps with a sticky Continue.

Motion is slow, soft and one-way: photos cross-fade and settle from a gentle zoom, frames unveil from the bottom as they enter, content rises in once, and a listing photo morphs from its card into the listing page. Nothing bounces, nothing loops for attention, and with reduced motion every element is simply present. The system refuses texture, material costume and decorative gimmicks; the user rejected a crafted, material direction as looking cheap.
keyCharacteristics: White and warm-stone grounds in alternation; colour comes only from photography.
Gambetta Light display over Supreme UI; tabular numerals for every price, area and count.
Large rounded photography (20px cards, 28px hero panels) with generous margins.
Ink pill buttons; a single ink focus ring; hairlines instead of boxes.
Slow cross-fades, bottom-up mask reveals, a 1.025 hover zoom, and a card-to-listing shared-element transition.
Mobile-first: rails, a swipeable photo strip, stepped forms, 44px+ targets.

rules.name: The Houses Carry the Colour Rule
rules.body: The interface is white, stone and ink. Any saturated colour on screen must come from a photograph.

rules.name: The Logo-Only Turquoise Rule
rules.body: Mar appears only as the logo badge. It is never a link colour, a button, an active state, a tint or a section ground.

rules.name: The Ink Means Act Rule
rules.body: A filled ink shape is either an action (pill button) or a chosen state (selected chip, active segment, checked box, progress). Ink is not used for decoration.

rules.name: The Light Serif Rule
rules.body: Display and section headings are Gambetta Light (300). Weight 400 is for small serif sizes (card titles, CRM subheads, prices); 500 is reserved.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every price, area, bedroom count, reference number, phone number and step counter uses tabular lining numerals.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at 0.01em tracking. The only uppercase text is the two-letter locale switch (EN/ES).

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface earns a shadow only when it floats over a photograph or answers a hover. Cards, form shells and sections never carry a resting shadow.

rules.name: The Glass Over Photos Rule
rules.body: Translucency and backdrop blur are used only where UI sits on imagery or scrolling content: the header, the hero villa chip, the card operation tag, the sticky filter bar and the phone form action bar.

dos: Do alternate white (#ffffff) and warm stone (#f6f4f0) sections and let the photographs supply all colour.
Do use the ink pill for the primary action on every surface, and the light or ghost pill beside it.
Do set display and section headings in Gambetta Light with negative tracking, and everything functional in Supreme.
Do round photographs at 20px (cards) or 28px (panels) and keep generous margins around them.
Do use tabular numerals for every price, area, count and phone number.
Do design at 390 wide first: rails for collections, a swipe strip for listing photos, sticky actions in forms, 44px minimum targets.
Do split long forms into validated steps with a progress bar, format money as it is typed, and use counters instead of typed numbers.
Do keep hover gentle: a 1.025 photo zoom over 2.2s, a 4px arrow nudge, a drawn underline.
Do carry a view-transition name from each card photo to its listing hero.
Do make every reveal one-way and give it a static fallback for no-JS and reduced motion.
donts: Don't add textures, grain, paper, woven or material patterns, or any costume that dresses the site as a craft object.
Don't use turquoise (#13c6c9) anywhere outside the logo badge: not for links, buttons, active states, tints or grounds.
Don't use aggressive hover: no zoom beyond 1.025 on photos, no card lifts, bounces, tilts or fast scale jumps.
Don't put eyebrows or kickers (small uppercase labels) above headings.
Don't use ghost wordmarks: no oversized, faded brand name or headline text as background decoration.
Don't invent claims: no testimonials, awards, press, sales figures or certifications beyond what the product facts support.
Don't add resting shadows to cards, sections or form shells.
Don't use faint (#9b978f) for body text.
